implemented_route: apps/cli -> Core::run -> input::structured_intent -> Intent::CsvGroupCount -> document::csv_group_count -> DocumentResult artifact
supported_behavior_from_source: The operation requires a valid CSV with an explicit unique named header and an existing selected column.
Each group is keyed by the exact decoded string in the selected column; no numeric conversion, whitespace trimming, case folding or Unicode normalization is performed.
Groups are returned in order of their first appearance, with an integer count for each value.
The report retains the selected source header and every member cell span, plus the source and output digests and group parameters.
Malformed CSV and missing columns return typed failures; CSV byte/row/column/cell/output bounds remain in force.
